clusters.narrative: IT WAS REPORTED THAT A MALFUNCTION ALARM OCCURRED. THE CUSTOMER REVERTED TO AN ALTERNATE METHOD OF INSULIN THERAPY. THERE WAS NO ADVERSE IMPACT TO THE CUSTOMER¿S BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVEL.
THE DEVICE IS EXPECTED TO BE RETURNED; HOWEVER, THE DEVICE HAS NOT YET BEEN RECEIVED. A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED IF THE DEVICE IS RECEIVED.
THE DEVICE HAS BEEN RECEIVED FOR EVALUATION; HOWEVER, DEVICE EVALUATION IS NOT YET COMPLETE. A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE FILED UPON COMPLETION OF THE EVALUATION.

IT WAS REPORTED THAT THE PUMP BATTERY WAS DEPLETING QUICKLY. THE CUSTOMER CONTINUED TO USE THE PUMP FOR INSULIN THERAPY. THERE WAS NO REPORTED IMPACT TO BLOOD GLUCOSE. CUSTOMER DECLINED TROUBLESHOOTING WITH TANDEM TECHNICAL SUPPORT.

clusters.problem: Adverse Event Without Identified Device or Use Problem
clusters.narrative: NO PRODUCT WAS RETURNED FOR EVALUATION. SHOULD NEW RELEVANT INFORMATION BECOME AVAILABLE, A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED.

IT WAS REPORTED THAT INTERMITTENT OCCLUSION ALARMS OCCURRED. CUSTOMER REPORTED USING APIDRA. TANDEM TECHNICAL SUPPORT INFORMED CUSTOMER THAT APIDRA IS OFF LABEL PER THE USER GUIDE. CUSTOMER CHANGED PUMP SUPPLIES TO ADDRESS THE ISSUE AND RESUMED INSULIN DELIVERY. CUSTOMER'S BLOOD GLUCOSE WAS 330 MG/DL.

IT WAS REPORTED THAT THE TOUCHSCREEN BECAME UNRESPONSIVE. THERE WAS NO PATIENT INVOLVEMENT, AS THE ISSUE OCCURRED DURING SETUP/TRAINING OF THE PUMP AND HAD NOT YET BEEN USED ON THE CUSTOMER AT THE TIME OF THE REPORTED EVENT. TROUBLESHOOTING WITH TANDEM TECHNICAL SUPPORT WAS PERFORMED BUTTON "1" WAS NOT RESPONDING.
THE DEVICE IS EXPECTED TO BE RETURNED; HOWEVER, THE DEVICE HAS NOT YET BEEN RECEIVED. A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED IF THE DEVICE IS RECEIVED.
